storyInfo: Popukar lives a peaceful life on Rhodes Island. Adults always think children understand nothing, but the truth is…

attributes.content: The best that I can say is, it's not getting worse. Yet.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Hm... Well, I suppose there isn't anything that can be done about it.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Compared to your situation, Popukar's numbers look pretty optimistic.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Although not so optimistic that we can stop monitoring her.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: That said, she's doing the right thing by going to bed early and getting up early in the morning. You could learn a thing or two from her.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: She has spent virtually her entire life living with Oripathy...
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Maybe that's a blessing, in a sense.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: The other day, I was reading a magazine with Popukar, and she said she hoped I could design clothes for her to wear when she grows up.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Will I get to see that day, though?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Try not to let that weigh on your mind.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Both for the sake of your condition... and her.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Okay.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: *sigh*.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Dr. Li! I finished the coloring book you gave me! Do you have another?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: So quick, Popukar? You're good.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: I did it with Bubble!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: We even drew ourselves drawing in the blank spaces.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Both of you are really good.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Here, I've got another coloring book.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Thank you, Doctor!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Bubble! I got a new coloring book!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: She's not in the game room?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I guess I'll wait for her to come back.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Did you sneak out from the wards too? I don't think I've seen you before.
attributes.name: Boy in Patient Gown

attributes.content: Huh? Who are you?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I'm Elwin. What is this place? There are so many toys everywhere.
attributes.name: Boy in Patient Gown

attributes.content: I'm Popukar. This is the Rhodes Island game room.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Are you lost? I can take you back.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: No. Ever since I got here, I’ve just been stuck in the ward. They won’t let me go out to play. What's that in your hand?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: A coloring book. Dr. Li gave it to me.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: You wanna do it with me?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I've never done one before. Is that okay?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Sure!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Dr. Li says the point of coloring is to have fun. We can draw whatever we want, as long as we don't get the table dirty.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: This is Felitubby, this is Littlemon, and there are a bunch of empty spaces where Bubble and I draw the folks of Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Oh, Bubble is my friend. She was here just now, but I don't know where she went.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Here, crayons. I always start with the brightest color.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Which one is the brightest?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: (Digs through the crayons)
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: This one! This red's really bright. I like it a lot.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: This crayon’s nearly got no tip left.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: I use it a lot because it's nice!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: It's short because it's been working hard.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Then I want to use the color of working hard.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Yellow's great too! It turns Felitubby into a tiny sun.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: (Draws intently with crayons)
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Do I have to stay in the lines?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: You can go outside just a little bit. Felitubby will get bored if we're too neat.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Really?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Yeah, I used to draw it real neat, but Dr. Li said it's like Felitubby's going to work.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Hah, I won't be so neat, then. I don't wanna go to work.
attributes.name: Elwin
Popukar
attributes.content: Going to work is actually kinda fun.

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: It's hard, though. I often hurt myself and the others when I wasn't good.

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: I'm getting pretty good at work, though.
Work? You? You look about the same age as me. Work should be for grown-ups.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: My mom and dad have to go to work, so they can't stay with me in the ward.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Why are you drawing these thick clothes for Felitubby?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: It's a protective suit. Sometimes I have to wear thick clothes when I go on missions. Felitubby won't get hurt if he wears thick clothes.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: What do I do with this? I drew a big hat for this Felitubby, but I don't think the hat will protect him.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Well... he doesn't have to go on a mission. He can draw pictures in front of a desk.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Every day?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Every day. He'll draw whatever he wants.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I'll draw lots of colors for him.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: People who are sitting and writing or drawing look more important.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: My mom and dad sit in front of a desk all day.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Oh...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Oh yeah, Miss Orchid is like that. The folks at Medical also sit in front of a desk every day to write reports.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Yeah, people who sit in front of a desk are important.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Elwin, there you are. The other doctors told me you snuck out again.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Oops, they found me.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Oh... so you've been coloring with Popukar here.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: It looks nice.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: This is... a Felitubby in a protective suit?
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Yes! Felitubby's going on a mission. He's really important.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: This Felitubby sits in front of a desk all day drawing. He's really important too.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Sits in front of a desk all day...?
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Yes, Popukar says that people who sit in front of a desk writing and drawing are important.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Like my mom and dad, and the doctors and nurses here, and, and—
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: And Miss Orchid, and the others!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I see...
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Can I borrow this page? I'll save it for you.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: You're confiscating it?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: No, saving it for you. That way, you can look at it anytime you want to.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Like Rhodes Island's filing cabinets?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Something like that.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Our drawing is awesome, Elwin! Rhodes Island's filing cabinets are awesome too.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Mm... okay.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Now it's time to go back, Elwin. You've been outside for a long time today.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Can I come and play again next time?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Well, it depends on whether you're a good boy in your blood check, which you need to go to now.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: I'll be good!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Bye, Popukar! See you next time!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Alright.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: There's still a lot of the coloring book left.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Hm... I'll wait until next time Elwin's here. Lemme do my homework now.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Your squad always wears proper protection when you're in the field, right?
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Of course.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: The scratch on Popukar's arm...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Just a small scratch, no sign of infection. Don't worry.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: A tactical error. My fault.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You're doing good work.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: The medical results are in. Not much change in the data compared to last time.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Still no significant drop in the cell assimilation rate... the suppressant is working, but there's no real improvement.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: I stopped hoping for improvement a long time ago.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: At her age, and based on where she started, though... the status quo is good news enough.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You'll be the one to tell her again?
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Just the general gist. I don't think she should know the details.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I don't want to give a little girl a health report and ask her to consider how long she has to live.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Do you think she has a chance to make it long enough for a breakthrough discovery?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: A 'chance' should not be how a doctor makes her bread.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: But this is what we're fighting for every day, here at Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Sometimes I wonder, is it better to be like Popukar, to contract Oripathy at a young age...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Or to be like me and the others, to contract the illness after we've lived our lives for a while.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: ...It's better to not get it at all, of course.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Heh... of course.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Would I have lived more freely and worried less, if I got infected at Popukar's age?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: But the fact is, children like her live under so many restrictions once they catch the illness...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Limitations placed upon them by adults.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: We tell them how they must not do this, how they must be careful of that.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: Not to mention she still has to go on missions.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: That's why I want her to live like a normal child outside of missions, to do normal things in a normal home.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: After all, going on missions and understanding these restrictions are two different things.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: All she needs to know is where to go, what to do, and that she'll be taken care of when she comes back. All she needs to be is a little bit more independent, on top of these things.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Yes. The rest is our job.
attributes.name: Dr. Li

attributes.content: (I was going to ask Dr. Li how long I need to press the cotton ball against my arm.)
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: (I'll ask another doctor. I should remember these things.)
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: (I'll keep it pressed for a little longer.)
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I think the bleeding's stopped.
attributes.name: Popukar
Popukar
attributes.content: I should throw the cotton ball into...

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: There, the medical trash bin.
I wonder if Miss Orchid is done with Dr. Li. I'll wait for her here.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I should finish writing the mission report.
attributes.name: Popukar
Popukar
attributes.content: I'll draw Miss Orchid, then Mr. Spot... he's raising his shield...

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: Hm, that's a little too round. Let's do this again...
Then a bunch of scary-looking bandits.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Mr. Midnight did this and this, then Miss Catapult did this and this, and the bandits went POW!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: How do you draw someone flying off their feet?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Miss Catapult went boom boom boom... and then the mission was done, and everybody's happy. I'll draw some smiles.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Mr. Midnight was complaining about how hot the desert was. I'll draw some sweat on his face.
attributes.name: Popukar
Popukar
attributes.content: Should I draw how my arm got hurt?

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: I'll do that, then draw a Popukar wearing a thick protective suit on the side... and brum brum brrrrr spinning real fast.
That means I won't get hurt again!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Alright, report's finished...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Popukar! There you are.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Elwin? Did you sneak out of the ward again?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: No! I got permission to come out for a little while today.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: I'm done with all my checks today, so I told the doctor I wanted to play with you, and they let me come to the game room.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: You completed a mission! That means you're all grown up.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: What are you drawing? A new coloring book?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: It's the report that I have to write after a field mission.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Field mission? What's that?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Going out to fight bad guys.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Oh, the 'work' that you were talking about!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: You fight bad guys? You're awesome.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Did you draw how you were fighting them? Wow, you have a big saw!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Yeah, brum brum brrrrr is awesome too!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: So this is a 'report'? I want to draw a report too.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: You wanna do it? A report is recording everything that happened that day. It's really easy.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Lemme get you a piece of paper... here, this is your report. Draw the things you did today.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: But all I did was get needles in me in the ward, then they let me come and play for a while.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: You can draw that too.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Is that a mission?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Hm...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I think it is. The doctors told you to do something, and you did it. That's a mission.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Did you do what they told you?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: ...A little.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Then draw a little.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: (Scribbles seriously)
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: But the only thing in the report is me lying on the bed getting dripped.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: How about I draw how I sneaked out of the ward the last time?
attributes.name: Elwin
Popukar
attributes.content: You can't draw yourself sneaking out!

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: But... I guess you got caught anyway.
Alright, then draw it smaller, like really tiny.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Would that be okay?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Yeah, you can pretend it's not so bad if people can't see it well.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Hah, you're smart.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: I want to be like you, going to work and fighting bad guys here.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Then you need to get better, and be really strong like me... or smart like Miss Orchid, or have a big shield like Mr. Spot.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: But only if the doctors say it's okay.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Then you can write lots of reports.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: But it's okay to think about it now.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Can I write it in the report, even if I'm just thinking about it?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: I think it's okay. You can draw what you did today, and what you want to do.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: That way, you'll know you were thinking about these things when you look at it in the future, and you won't forget.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I often draw everyone in A6 standing together and smiling happily, although what actually happens is that Miss Catapult is usually being scolded by Miss Orchid.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: The boy in the patient's gown gazes at the blank sheet in front of him, then draws a small dot in a corner.
This is the 'future'.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: So small?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Because I don't know how big it's gonna be, so I'll draw it smaller at first. That way, there'll be plenty of room for 'future' to grow bigger.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Then I'll draw a 'future' too.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Popukar draws a small dot in a corner of her completed report, then adds four small dots around it.
This way, my 'future' will grow too.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: And the futures of Orchid, Catapult, Spot, and Midnight.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Sometimes they frown when they're reading the reports, sometimes they smile. Maybe they're thinking about the future too.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Will you draw them frowning?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Yes, but smaller. If you draw the sad things too big, they'll frown even more when they see it. That's not good.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: When mom and dad came to see me, they brought a lot of folders, and they were frowning at those papers.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: But they never tell me what's on the paper.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: That means they put sad things on paper like the doctors here, and put them inside the door, so that we only see the things that are nice.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Don't you get mad that they don't tell you the truth?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Hm...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I think they still tell us the truth, but just the parts about what to do today, and what to do tomorrow.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: What about all the stuff that's left?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Those are reports for the grown-ups.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Grown-ups have grown-up reports. They have to write a lot of stuff about the future. Kids have kid reports, and we only have to write about today, and a little bit about the future.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: That seems so hard... I don't understand.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Mom and dad say that once I get out of hospital, we may have to move house and go to a new school. They're always planning a bunch of things that I don't understand, and I don't dare ask.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: But you look like you know what you're doing more.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Because I peeked.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Not the paper, but the faces of the grown-ups. They frown and sigh when they read the reports, but when I walk into the room, they smile and tell me Popukar has been a good girl today.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Yeah, that's what my mom and dad do.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: So I thought... they already frowned enough inside the door. Outside the door, I want to draw things that make them smile.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Like what you just drew?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Yeah. That way, when they look at my reports, they see that I completed my mission today, and I did my homework, and smiled and laugh with the others.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Are we drawing the future so that the grown-ups will be happy?
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: That's half of it.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: The other half is so that, when the future actually comes, I can tell it, 'See? I left a place for you.'
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: That sounds so cool! I need to remember that.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: When I'm as awesome as you and I can lift a big saw like you, I want to work here and say cool stuff like you, except I'll be even cooler!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Hehe.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: And I'll be all grown up. Maybe I'm even helping Miss Orchid make clothes!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Miss Orchid's always cutting cloth with tiny scissors. Maybe brum brum brrrrr can make lots of clothes in one spin!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Then I wanna draw more good things for them.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: That way, when they look at my report, they'll see that today wasn't so bad.
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: The boy draws a ring of color around the 'future' on his sheet of paper, like a faint halo.
Popukar? Are you there?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Oh, it's Miss Orchid.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Didn't I tell you to wait for me outside the infirmary? What are you doing in the game room?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: (Whisper) Oh no, I forgot.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: But I finished my report here!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Popukar taught me how to write reports. We drew a lot of 'futures'!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Oh, I think I have to go back to the ward now. We'll play together again next time, Popukar!
attributes.name: Elwin

attributes.content: Sure! We'll write reports together again.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Reports about the future...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Alright, you've written your report, time to shower and go to bed.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Otherwise, you won't have the strength to draw a new report tomorrow.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Okay—
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: And get up earlier tomorrow, so I can take your measurements.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I happen to have some time on my hands, so I thought I would make you some new clothes. You want to work on them together?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Yeah!
attributes.name: Popukar
